Its original five value/type/row tests remain, its three source/validation cases are unchanged, and the nearest five row/mode tests verify retained buffers and parsed Apply behavior. The separate passive JSON-mode reset was repaired, not approved by this buffer counterexample.

P110 reassessed 2026-11-17: The surviving StructuredJsonEditor content effect accepts a replacement external value while local content remains an independently edited, potentially invalid JSON buffer until Apply. Invalid Apply emits no value and reports the JSON error; valid Apply emits the parsed object and returns to structured fields. That buffer contract cannot be replaced by formatting props on every render. The former second target, the valueType-driven editInJson reset effect, was a genuine passive correction and has been removed in favor of guarded local type identity; the prior mode rationale is withdrawn. Root ran the unchanged nearest five plus parent eight cases successfully. This review covers the remaining content buffer effect and does not retain an exception for the deleted mode effect.
